**T2 decisions: none.** No event has a snapshot session of today, `due.py t2-list` is empty, nothing was gated, nothing was frozen, no decision written. The fire arrived early and the pre-check found nothing due, so this was a housekeeping run only. `check.py` PASS.

**PENDING changes — LEVI is confirmed, the first of the three to resolve.**

| name | source read today | result |
|---|---|---|
| **LEVI** | IR press-release feed + detail page, HTTP 200, item published **2026-09-23 09:00 ET** | **CONFIRMED.** Call for the quarter ended Aug 30 is "Wednesday, October 7, 2026, at 2 p.m. Pacific / **5 p.m. Eastern**". No session wording for the release, so AMC by call time (`session_from_call_time`). Inside the pilot window → snapshot **Tue Oct 6**, entry **Oct 7 open**. `confirm.json` written. |
| **AEHR** | aehr.com/newsroom, HTTP 200 | Still PENDING. Newest item unchanged at 2026-09-03; the ~Sep 28 announcement its own 7-day lead implies has not come. yfinance unchanged at Nov 2 15:00, intraday. |
| **APLD** | ir.applieddigital.com RSS, HTTP 200 | Still PENDING. Newest item unchanged at 2026-07-27 16:05 ET; the ~Sep 26 date its 12-day lead implies has not come. Nasdaq still Oct 8 `time-not-supplied`. |

**The uncomfortable part of the LEVI confirmation:** neither second source agrees with the company yet. yfinance still returns the stale **2026-09-30 16:00**, and the Nasdaq calendar lists LEVI on **2026-10-08** with `time-not-supplied`, which does not qualify as a session under D003 §6. `s2_gate.py` re-reads both inside the window on Oct 6; if neither shows Oct 7 AMC by then, the event is INELIGIBLE `unconfirmed`. That is code's call, not this step's — I recorded the company source and the warning, and did not pre-judge it.

**Freeze commits:** none (nothing gated). Housekeeping commit `e180fc0`, pushed to origin/main.

**Nothing failed.** The two scheduler commits from this morning (`0eb3314` six fires per window, `f70ab06` `due.py wait`) are on main; STATE.md now records that the human ask is closed. The pilot stands at three events lost (PAYX, DRI, BB) and seven live: AIR + JBL (Sep 28) · MU (Sep 29) · NKE (Sep 30) · PENG (Oct 5) · LEVI (Oct 6). Monday Sep 28 is the first real test of the fix — still zero events gated to date.
